about: Patch notes for the toy pages, newest first by stamp. One entry per patch; post_update.py appends. Times are Mountain Time.

updates.name: Night watcher
updates.note: 0.2.22: the night watcher is now a hooded skeleton (KayKit Skeleton_Rogue) with glowing eyes; it walks, watches, flinches and collapses. Its strike is a stand-in throw [placeholder]. Hitbox, speed and AI unchanged.

updates.name: Star twinkle
updates.note: 0.2.21 CL: the night and dusk skies' stars now twinkle softly (dim to about 40%, 1-3 s each, on their own clock), a little more near the horizon, and keep twinkling under the Wake tint. The moons stay steady. No toggle.

updates.name: V7: dusk hound model
updates.note: Night hounds are wolves now: a near-black Quaternius wolf (CC0) with ember eyes that walks while it wanders, gallops when it hunts you, lunges on the bite, flinches when hit and falls where it dies. Same hound underneath: size, speed, damage and AI unchanged.

updates.name: V7: player model
updates.note: You are the KayKit Rogue now: first person shows its own arms holding the sword, axe or loot weapon, and the Worn panel shows the whole Rogue, tinted by what you wear. Swings use a stand-in throw motion until the animation pack arrives.

updates.name: V7: road ghost fix
updates.note: The red delete outline the Road gun shows over a road piece no longer folds over itself on tight bends: on hairpins and short curves part of it used to turn upside down and vanish. Roads, saves and the gun are otherwise unchanged.

updates.name: V7: licensed sounds
updates.note: Licensed sound packs fill the quiet moments: footsteps in time with your stride, chests, doors, portal, Wake sting, hurt and death, forest and cave ambience.

updates.name: V7: weapons kit
updates.note: Swords, axes and the stone loot weapons now show real flat-shaded models in your hand and in the inventory and crafting pictures.

updates.name: Map roads and POIs
updates.note: Both maps now draw every road in dark gray with yellow dashes, show ruins, villages, keeps and dungeons with an icon and name once you have seen them, and a Map settings menu toggles each layer.

updates.name: Roads
updates.note: New worlds get an endless main road with dirt trail branches to the POIs, sunk into the ground and joined at T junctions.

updates.name: Sky day/night plates
updates.note: The sky is now your day, dusk and night pictures, turning once a day and melting into each other at dusk and dawn.

updates.name: Sky moon
updates.note: A moon now crosses the night sky from east to west, and on Wake nights a red portal moon ripples open over it, then switches off like an old TV at dawn if you survive.

updates.name: Sky sun
updates.note: Jonny's sun picture now rises in the east at dawn, crosses the sky on the day clock and sets in the west at dusk; hidden at night.

updates.name: Build Bot: version label
updates.note: A small version tag (v0.2.10) now sits in the bottom-right corner of the menu and the game.

updates.name: Pickable saplings
updates.note: Felled trees can drop a sapling of their wood; plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a tree in about 3 days.

updates.name: Bush clumps
updates.note: Bushes that touch now grow into one clump, tall in the middle and lower toward the edges; it's only the look, and crouching anywhere in a clump hides you.

updates.name: Night hunters and the mob-spawner cube
updates.note: Ordinary nights now bring hounds and watchers that hunt you down unless you hide, and a placeable mob-spawner cube breeds them nearby.

updates.name: Moves and the repair hammer
updates.note: Stone weapons get moves: dagger jabs, a spear you can throw, a hammer spin and slam that dazes, and the repair hammer now mends worn blocks.

updates.name: Loot block, Score, Sheet and Augments
updates.note: Marked loot blocks roll a scored sheet with augments; daggers, spear, war hammer, anti-armor sword and stone armor added.

updates.name: P5 small jobs
updates.note: Build Bot: the first hit on a block no longer hitches, and world resets and self-tests are steadier.

updates.name: Observer
updates.note: A read-only watcher now runs with the game; the pause page shows frame times, slow frames and errors.

updates.name: Hands and body plus Armor
updates.note: An Off hand slot next to Pack, first-person arms whose sleeves follow your chest piece, and stone armor rules ready for the stone pieces.

updates.name: Block destruction
updates.note: Hit blocks now wear away as little cubes, mostly from the side you hit, and ore shows its core inside.

updates.name: POI capture
updates.note: Press Insert in a game to pause it, size a box around you from above, and save the land inside as a POI capture you can open in the editor.

updates.name: POI gallery
updates.note: The POI Maker is now a previewer: real block shapes and textures on the table, plus a gallery to pick, view, edit or test any POI.

updates.name: POI editor
updates.note: The POI Workshop is now an editor outside the game: a free camera with a tool panel, line, rectangle, box and plane fills, undo, and a POI library.

updates.name: Build Bot: distance rendering
updates.note: Build Bot's distance rendering is in: the far land past the real chunks is now drawn as blocky columns in the real block colours with water, snow tops and far trees, chunks build without stalling (worst frames about half), and a 60 fps cap is on by default.

updates.name: Cave crack fix
updates.note: The crack near the start is now always in sight: the search checks several sight lines from eye height and re-checks after the cut.

updates.name: Cave look test
updates.note: New worlds carve angular Voronoi cave tunnels that widen deep down, with one thin crack breaking the ground in sight of the start.

updates.name: POI maker pass 3
updates.note: New POI Maker door: your Workshop build sits on a table you orbit and zoom; set a claim block, size the bubble, click to smart pick, export it, or drop in for a test.

updates.name: Pebble shine
updates.note: The light pebbles on the meteor ground's black sand now catch a rainbow sheen that shifts as you move.
